property_summary: For any recipient and any initial contract balance > 0, a successful withdrawAll call by the owner must leave the contract balance at 0; the buggy version sends 1 ether to the owner before transferring the rest, violating this invariant when the initial balance is less than 1 ether.
change_summary: Insert 'payable(owner).transfer(1 ether);' before the existing transfer, changing the balance before the original transfer executes.
